about.included.b: One full single-player season: pick a club, set your lineup and training, draft heroes against the clock, set your game plan, watch the match, read the report. 10 clubs, 18 league rounds, then a top-4 playoff. You also run the money, sign and renew players, and build team chemistry. New in this build: a guided first game, a ? help button on every screen, lessons and a glossary. Your progress saves automatically.
about.test.b: New in this build: the guided first game, help on every screen, lessons and the glossary. Did you know what to do next without asking anyone? Which step slowed you down? Is a game still about 5 minutes with the draft? Anything confusing, slow or broken?
